content: The Habana Leon brand was established by José Pepin Garcia and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. The brand pays homage to one of Cuba's historic baseball teams, the Club Habana team, which was also known as the Habana Leones (Havana Lions). This team was affectionately referred to as los Rojos (The Reds) due to their team color. The cigar brand honors this iconic Cuban baseball team, and the design of the cigar band reflects this theme, featuring a red background with gold lettering. The cigar itself is characterized as full-bodied. Its filler is composed of 70% Nicaraguan ligero tobacco, which is known for its strength and bold flavor. The wrapper is also Nicaraguan, specifically a Corojo wrapper grown in Nicaragua from the 2000 crop. The brand offers a single line of cigars, which includes seven different vitolas (sizes or shapes).
